title: Mesa Manor w/Mini Golf | Ping Pong | WiFi | BBQ
description:
Stay in Mesa, Arizona, at this spacious getaway, perfect for groups of up to 30 guests! 🌵 With 8 bedrooms and plenty of room to relax and unwind, this home is ideal for making unforgettable memories. Enjoy a fun and comfortable stay while exploring everything Mesa has to offer! ☀️🏡

☀ Swimming Pool with Volleyball & light up games!
☀ Ping Pong Table
☀ Mini Golf
☀ Basketball court with neon lights!

 The space 
☀ Welcome to your perfect getaway in Mesa, Arizona, where everything is designed for your comfort and enjoyment. Take a relaxing bath with free shampoo, conditioner, and body soap, with hot water always ready. The kitchen has everything you need, including a fridge, microwave, stove, oven, and coffee maker, along with a cozy dining area to enjoy your meals.

☀ The entertainment options are endless with a TV, ping pong table, & mini golf. Relax in air-conditioned comfort with ceiling fans & heating for your convenience in Mesa, Arizona. For safety, the property is equipped with exterior security cameras, smoke & carbon monoxide alarms, a fire extinguisher & a first aid kit.

☀ Enjoy fast WiFi and a workspace to stay connected. Step outside to the patio or balcony with comfy seating. Fire up the BBQ, relax on the sun loungers, or take a dip in your private pool and hot tub. Free parking is included. Plus, self check-in with a smart lock makes your stay in Mesa, Arizona, easy and hassle-free.
